queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN l.contract_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONTRACT_ORDER'::text ELSE 'INVOICE'::text END AS source, (i.id::text || '-' || l.id::text) AS row_key, i.id::text AS invoice_id, l.id::text AS invoice_line_id, l.contract_order_id::text AS contract_order_id, i.invoice_number::text AS invoice_number, c.contract_number::text AS contract_number, l.order_number::integer AS order_number, l.royalty_order_number::integer AS royalty_order_number, l.royalty_invoice_number::text AS royalty_invoice_number, l.aggregate::text AS aggregate, l.quantity::numeric AS quantity, l.unit_price::numeric AS unit_price, l.line_total_excl_vat::numeric AS line_total_excl_vat, COALESCE(l.order_date, i.invoice_date)::date AS source_date, i.created_at AS sort_date FROM sales_invoices i INNER JOIN sales_invoice_lines l ON l.invoice_id = i.id LEFT JOIN contracts c ON c.id = i.contract_id WHERE i.status IN ('FINANCE_APPROVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED')

SELECT rbi.invoice_line_id::text AS invoice_line_id, rbi.contract_order_id::text AS contract_order_id FROM royalty_batch_items rbi INNER JOIN royalty_batches rb ON rb.id = rbi.batch_id WHERE UPPER(rb.status) IN ('FINAL', 'FINALIZED')
